PR: Add read-only commands for `ArtifactGenerator` kind [closed; labels area/ux]
This PR adds the following commands to the Flux CLI:
- `flux export artifact generator` - Exports one or more `ArtifactGenerators` from the cluster in YAML format
- `flux get artifact generator` - Lists the `ArtifactGenerators` and their status
- `flux tree artifact generator` - Prints the list of ExternalArtifacts managed by an `ArtifactGenerator`
- `flux events --for ArtifactGenerator/<name>` - Prints the events emitted by source-watcher for an `ArtifactGenerator`

Part of: #5514
